core_principle.description: Preserve high conditional learnability (signatures, neighbors, intra-district candidate structure) while preventing direct single-variable geography shortcuts and global/fraud cluster mode collapse.
core_principle.formal_representation: Balanced Stage-1 evidence channels with max 30-35% contribution cap per channel + Stage-2 district-size normalized role-cluster rotation with 6% historical popularity cap.

seed_universe.unconsumed_protection: Seeds 39184, 39185, 39186 are strictly UNGENERATED in this design phase. Previous seeds 36185, 36186, 37185, 37186, 38185, 38186 remain ungenerated and retired.

dataset_specifications.chronological_ordering: Strict chronological ordering by event_timestamp with no pre-split shuffling

two_stage_hierarchical_architecture.flow: PRE-EVENT OBSERVABLES -> Stage 1 Budget-Capped Multi-Channel District Scoring -> REALIZED CASHOUT DISTRICT -> Stage 2 Rotated District-Local Portfolio Cluster Selection -> REALIZED CASHOUT CLUSTER

hard_geographic_invariant.enforcement: Stage 2 candidate clusters are strictly restricted to the subset belonging to the sampled realized district.

normalization_contract.rules: District distribution sum == 1.0 within 1e-9; Cluster distribution sum == 1.0 within 1e-9; Sampling must execute on full-precision float64 vectors before any serialization formatting.
normalization_contract.serialization_policy: Serialized 4-decimal JSON strings remain reporting/diagnostic fields only and do not alter generation probabilities.

stage_1_district_transition_redesign.objective: Derive P(cashout_district | observables) across 11 revenue districts with distributed evidence channels and anti-shortcut bounds

evidence_consensus_and_conflict_handling.consensus_rule: High preferred district mass (0.45 - 0.58) requires agreement across at least 3 independent channels (e.g. terminal mule == dominant account == majority downstream).
evidence_consensus_and_conflict_handling.conflict_rule: When terminal mule district != dominant account district != dominant flow district, increase dispersion across adjacent corridors (0.22 - 0.35) and long-tail mass (0.15 - 0.25).
evidence_consensus_and_conflict_handling.consensus_scaling: Consensus multiplier bounded to [1.0, 1.4] rather than V6.2's overpowered [1.0, 2.2].

stage_2_cluster_selection_redesign.objective: Derive P(cashout_cluster | realized_district, archetype, observables) within realized district with primary portfolio rotation and anti-mode-collapse controls

district_local_functional_role_system.primary_portfolio_rotation: Within each district, primary cluster eligibility rotates across available role-compatible clusters using case modulo hashing. No single commercial or retail cluster is perpetually the primary option.
district_local_functional_role_system.district_size_normalization: For districts with limited cluster counts (e.g. NORTH_EAST with 1 cluster, NEW_DELHI with 3 clusters), role bonuses are normalized against cluster inventory to prevent per-cluster case accumulation.

sub_prototype_portfolio_mapping.role_mapping_policy: Each sub-prototype maps to 2-3 functional roles. Cluster selection chooses from rotated local portfolios.

fraud_cluster_decoupling.rule: Strictly NO fraud-specific cluster ID mapping. Fraud types map exclusively to functional role preferences (Retail, ATM, Branch) distributed across all 11 districts.
fraud_cluster_decoupling.marketplace_fraud_distribution: Marketplace fraud role weight is smoothed across MIXED_RETAIL_CORRIDOR, SECONDARY_COMMERCIAL_CORRIDOR, and LOCAL_BRANCH_NETWORK, dispersing across 25+ clusters and strictly preventing Seelampur from exceeding 15.0%.

entropy_monitoring: H(cluster | recurring_signature) in [2.0, 3.2] bits (meaningful conditional focus without mode collapse)
H(cluster | fraud_type) >= 4.8 bits (strong multi-cluster fraud dispersal)
H(district | route_consensus) < H(district) (verifiable predictive information without determinism)

anti_gaming_rules.rule_1: No post-generation cluster quota enforcement or row deletion.
anti_gaming_rules.rule_2: No target reassignment after seeing validation metrics.
anti_gaming_rules.rule_4: All distributions must arise organically from the frozen probabilistic mathematical formulation.
